terms.grammar: prepositional phrase: sine with the ablative
terms.comment: Literally “without paint and deceits”: fūcus is the dye or rouge that makes a thing look better than it is.

sources: Lewis & Short: fucus · Lewis & Short: fallacia
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 98, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
